title: Timestamp vlog
one_liner: Short clips stamped with their real recorded time in the same spot, the same swipe between every clip, a warm daylight look and a shutter on the last shot.
best_for: Service businesses with a visible process, and "a day (or week) in my business"
pace: 10-25 s; clips 1-3 s, final 3-4 s (the demo build was 10.6 s, four clips)
signature_moves: Chip with the clip's real recorded time, never moving, words blur-swap mid-swipe
One 6-frame swipe-left on every cut, with a different soft whoosh each time
White flash + camera shutter on the final shot
